kernel.boot: A native event fired when the kernel has booted (before addons/router).
kernel.configure_error_handling: Kernel step: configure PHP error/exception handling.
kernel.configure_debug: Kernel step: bind debugbar/debug renderer into container.
kernel.configure_view_engine: Kernel step: configure view engine and bind ViewEngineInterface.
kernel.configure_orm: Kernel step: configure ORM and bind Doctrine EntityManager/Connection.
kernel.configure_redis: Kernel step: configure Redis and bind Redis client into container.
kernel.configure_addons: Kernel step: initialize addons and register addon event handlers.
kernel.configure_router: Kernel step: create Router and attach addon routes.
kernel.handle_request: Kernel step: handle current request via Router (emits request.* events).
kernel.handle_tests: Kernel step: handle test requests (emits tests.* events).
request.context.created: A native event fired when RequestContext has been created and bound into the container.
request.received: A native event fired when a request has been received (before routing).
response.sent: A native event fired right before a response is sent to the client.
request.completed: A native event fired when a request has completed.
request.failed: A native event fired when a request has failed.
